releases.notes:
### Major Changes
- Switched config UI from Cloth Config to YACL (Yet Another Config Lib)
  - YACL is now required for the in-game config screen; Cloth Config is no longer used
  - Configs auto migrate on first load, existing categories, formats, and share codes still work
- Internal data model rewrite: hardcoded clans/players lists are now stored as a generic `groupValues` map keyed by regex group name
  - Existing configs auto-migrate on load (`clans` -> `Clans`, `players` -> `Usernames`)
### New Features
- User-Defined Categories
  - The hardcoded Own / Allied / Enemy / Neutral split is gone
  - Create categories to your heart's content, new options for customisation as well!
- Generic Regex Group Support
  - Lists are no longer hardcoded to "Players" and "Clans" - the screen builder reads named groups from your regex and creates one list per group
  - Format strings use `%groupName%` placeholders for any group (e.g. `%Rank% %Usernames% [%Clans%]`)
- Per-Category Server Filters (advanced mode :O)
  - Each category can be restricted to specific servers
  - With dot = exact match (`stray.gg`), without dot = substring match (`eu` matches `eu.stray.gg`)
  - Comma-separated, empty means "all servers"
- Per category Regex Override
- Stray+ rank now renders outside of stray
### Migration Notes
- Existing configs are automatically migrated on first load
- Old `ST1:`, `ST1C:`, `ST1F:` share codes are still accepted by the new import system; new exports use the `ST2:` prefix
- The legacy `clans` and `players` fields on a category are migrated to `groupValues["Clans"]` and `groupValues["Usernames"]` respectively
- The legacy `findCategory(username, clan, ...)` API is kept as a wrapper around the new generic matcher for any external code or mixins that depended on it

releases.notes:
### New Features
- Import / Export System
  - Added shareable config codes for clans, formats, or full server configs
  - Export fields generate a Base64 code (prefixed `ST1C:`, `ST1F:`, or `ST1:`) that you can copy and share with other players
  - Import fields let you paste a code and apply it on save
- Format Preview
  - Each format field now shows a preview below it displaying what the nametag would look like
  - Preview updates when you reopen the config screen after saving
- Debug Commands Config Toggle
  - Debug commands are now only available with Debug turned on (disabled by default)
  - When disabled, `/straytags test`, `testuser`, `verbose`, and `debug` are not registered at all and won't appear in autocomplete
  - `/straytags reload` remains always available
### Bug Fixes
- Cloth config optional requirement
  - Cloth config is actually optional now for lunar client, however it is still recommended since the in game configuration menu will not work without it
- Clanless Player Format Fix
  - Players added to own/allied/enemy player lists now correctly get their category's format even if they have no clan tag
- Whitelist entries without corresponding serverConfigs entries never got a config tab. Create missing entries on screen open.

releases.notes:
## Only tested on 1.21.11 Fabric 0.141.3 Loader 0.18.4
Tired of clan leaders changing their tag clan tag colour every 5 minutes?\
With this mod, you can freely customise the nametags of players so that your colour recognition isn't messed up by clan leaders.\
## Dependencies
- Fabric API
- Cloth Config + Mod Menu (optional, for in game config screen)
## Rundown
- Intercepts TextDisplay entities riding players (used by servers like stray.gg for nametags) and reformats them based on configurable clan/player categories using MiniMessage formatting.
- Mixin into DisplayRenderer.TextDisplayRenderer to intercept nametag rendering
- Strips § color codes and Unicode icons (SVC, TierTagger) for clean pattern matching and preserves them for reapplication
- Per server configuration with regex based name parsing
- Player and clan categorization: Own, Allied, Enemy, Neutral
- MiniMessage format strings with %username%, %clan%, %rank% placeholders
- Partial server address matching (eu.stray.gg matches stray.gg config)
## Commands
- /straytags test <string>     - test a raw string against the config pattern
- /straytags testuser [player] - inspect a player's nametag (has to be within render)
- /straytags verbose           - toggle logging of all processed nametags to chat
- /straytags debug             - toggle raw/cleaned string comparison logging
- /straytags reload            - reload config from disk
## Config
JSON config at config/straytags.json\
Cloth Config + Mod Menu integration for in game editing\
Server whitelist with per server clan lists and format overrides\
Default stray.gg config with pre-populated clan/player lists for Latte
